notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). The package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); no hardware run is claimed and no hardware backend exists. The card's family-config GymnasiumDriver shape is kept: native is the card's entry symbol gym_ur5.envs:UR5Env, env_id is ur5-v0, and only the R0 catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are bound. The upstream is the legacy gym API (reset() takes no seed and returns the observation only, step() returns obs, reward, done, info; ur5_env.py:61-71 and 107-113) and the Gymnasium bridge handles that legacy shape, so no shape deviation from the card was needed. The sim backend was not run: it needs CoppeliaSim with the UR5-Gripper-thread-pyapi.ttt scene, the upstream package installed, legacy gym importable and the PyCopp remoteApi library for the platform (the clone vendors only remoteApi.dll, pycopp/sim.py:11-21); ur5-v0 is registered with gym, not gymnasium, so the bridge's gym.make fallback is not reached when gymnasium is installed. The fake backend is this package's pure Python kinematic stand-in (fake.py), not compared with CoppeliaSim: it clips the action to the observation +-0.1 as ur5_env.py:64 does, integrates that offset into the published XYZ position, returns the six-value observation and the legacy four-value step tuple. Its start position, target position, force vectors, movePathDone and isTracking values are test data marked '# placeholder'; the three force values are constant, so the last three observation values never change, the target never moves and the path never completes. The fidelity contract publishes engine coppeliasim:UR5-Gripper-thread-pyapi.ttt, level F1, clock lockstep, realtime_factor 0, full reset and no snapshot. fidelity.timestep_ms is 0 because the timestep is configured inside the binary CoppeliaSim scene and the upstream code neither reads nor reports it (the only value is the commented-out 0.5 s at ur5_env.py:30); no number was invented for it. determinism.kind is none because the environment has no seed and no get_state/set_state and no repeatability test against CoppeliaSim was run; the cap.world.* bindings still carry the Gymnasium bridge's derived 'seeded' field, which is the bridge's default and not a claim of this driver, and the fidelity notes say so. No Limits are declared: the only bound is the action Box(-1.0, 1.0, shape=(3,)) that the bridge derives from the environment's action space and enforces; ticks is bounded 1..10000 by the bridge. Five warnings are expected and left as PLAYBOOK.md section 8 describes: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only configures the next reset and makes no native call) and G8.NO_UNIT for the integer inputs the bridge derives (reset seed, seed seed, ticks) and for the simulator-defined action.values. No image or large array is bound or needed: UR5Env reads no camera image; the kinect_rgb handle is used only by _getTargetPosFromKinect, which _get_obs does not call, so there is no NOT COVERED array. No catalogue requests: only cap.world.* classes are used, and no x-cap id is declared.
